name: SHADOW PROTOCOL
detailed_description:
Every word could save the world.

A rogue syndicate is minutes away from triggering global chaos — and only your keyboard can stop it.

Built entirely in Python using Pygame, Shadow Protocol delivers fast-paced word puzzles wrapped in neon-drenched spy visuals and driven by a cinematic synth soundtrack. It’s a tense, single-player thriller where precision typing and quick thinking decide the fate of the world.

🔑 Key Features

🧩 Word-Based Spy Puzzles

Crack cleverly crafted clues under pressure — one perfect word is all it takes.

⏱️ 1-Minute Missions

Fast, focused levels that keep the adrenaline high and the stakes higher.

🎚️ Adaptive Difficulty

Smart hints support new players. Veterans face a brutal test of logic and reflex.

🎵 Cinematic Synth Score

A high-energy original soundtrack propels every operation forward.

🕹️ Pure Single-Player Focus

No online accounts. No microtransactions. Just gameplay.

💻 Now Available on Windows

Play natively on Windows systems (64-bit).

💻 How It Works

A coded hint flashes on your secure terminal.

Type the correct word before time runs out.

Success defuses the threat. Failure raises the global danger meter.

Complete every mission to dismantle the syndicate’s master plan.

🤝 Connect With the Developer

I’d also like to extend an open invitation:

If you’re a content creator, streamer, curator, journalist, or even just a passionate gamer, and you’d like to share, feature, or give feedback on Shadow Protocol — I’d love to connect with you.

Whether it’s promotion, support, or constructive criticism, I welcome it all.

📧 Contact me at:

shawnfuteran.dev@gmail.com

Sharpen your wits. Trust no one. One word can change everything in Shadow Protocol.

short_description: Suit up as an elite undercover agent in Shadow Protocol, a fast-paced, word-powered spy puzzle built entirely in Python. Crack cryptic clues, complete rapid-fire missions, and outwit a global threat. Now available on Windows.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit, version 1909 or later) / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 (2 cores @ 3.9 GHz), AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or Higher
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 (DirectX 9.0c/OpenGL 2.1 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible audio device (built-in Windows audio is fine)
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit, version 21H2 or later) / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U (4 cores/8 threads, 1.6 GHz base / 3.4 GHz boost) or AMD Ryzen 5 3500U
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (2 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB) / Intel UHD 620 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: None

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 or Higher
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (or better; universal build supports both)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Apple/Intel) or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
